luna: Unit 1 vowel drill: the cleanest u in common Italian. Taught for its sound; no meaning is taught in this unit.
gnocchi: Unit 1: the gn sound. Chosen because a child already knows the word, which is the point of using it.
spaghetti: Unit 1: the only job of the h is to keep the g hard, and this is the word everyone has already seen.
cane / canne: Unit 1 minimal pair for the double consonant. cane is on the list; canne exists only as its contrast.
copia / coppia: Unit 1 minimal pair for the double consonant. Neither is taught for meaning.
